messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@fintechco.com>, Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@fintechco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-09T15:02:00Z
Subject: Post-demo: Redwood Inference — buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks again for taking the time to join the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your timeline.

Attendees & roles:
- Jane Sullivan — Head of Product (FintechCo)
- Michael Thompson — CFO / economic buyer
- Raj Patel — Procurement
- Priya Rao — Security (not on the call, will review docs)
- Marissa Cole — Redwood (AE)
- Connor O'Brien — Redwood (Legal/Commercial)
- Rishi Malhotra — Redwood (Solutions Engineer)

Key takeaways:
- You liked the latency/cost profile shown in the live demo and the model routing/fallback behavior.
- Primary decision criteria: latency SLA (p95 < 350ms for expected pilot traffic), data residency & auditability, predictable unit economics.
- Procurement timeline: target vendor selection by end of March; pilot (POC) in April.

Open items & owners:
1) Security: SOC 2, data flow diagram, encryption at rest — Rishi to provide details (rishi@redwood.com)
2) Commercial: preliminary pricing and pilot terms — Marissa/Connor to propose
3) Procurement: standard contract edits & PO process — Raj to share template and timeline

Proposed next steps:
- Share SOC 2 summary, pricing starter deck, and a mutual action plan (attached) — by EOD tomorrow.
- 30-min follow-up for security deep-dive with Rishi and Priya — propose Tue/Wed next week.
- Draft pilot SOW and pricing for review — target 48 hours.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Summary_v1.pdf, Redwood_Pricing_StarterDeck.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_FINTECHCO.xlsx

If that aligns, I’ll schedule the security call and loop in Connor for commercial. Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

—Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference — buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A couple procurement items from our side: 

- Can you share a sample SOW and standard commercial terms (MSA + order form)? We typically review redlines on the MSA and need to confirm indemnity/data handling clauses.
- We have a preferred PO process (PO issued after a mutually agreed SOW and prices). Timeline: procurement review completes ~1 week after doc submission.

If you can include an estimated pilot cost (not final, ballpark for PO approval), that would help accelerate internal alignment.

Thanks,
Raj
Procurement Manager | FintechCo
raj.patel@fintechco.com
From: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference — buying committee recap & next steps

Appreciate the demo — a couple of calls outs from my side as economic buyer:

1) We need a clearer picture on unit economics at scale. Can you provide the pricing tiers you plan to propose for the pilot and for a production ramp (1k qps / 5k qps scenarios)?
2) Security: please include SOC 2 Type II report or summary and a concise data flow diagram showing what leaves our environment, retention windows, and logging/audit capabilities.
3) SLA: we need p95 and p99 latency commitments and an outline of remedies for SLA misses (credits, priority routing).

If you can get those items to us this week, we’ll prioritize the vendor evaluation.

—Michael Thompson
CFO | FintechCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Michael Thompson <michael.thompson@fintechco.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@fintechco.com>, Jane Sullivan <jane.sullivan@fintechco.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T12:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference — buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Michael — great questions. Quick responses and next steps below. Full details attached.

Security & compliance (Rishi will lead the deep-dive):
- Attached: Redwood_Security_Summary_v1.pdf (SOC 2 summary, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, audit log retention). We can share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; Rishi can coordinate.
- Data flow: in the attached summary we include a concise diagram and preservation/retention options (customer-configurable).

Pricing & SLAs:
- Attached: Redwood_Pricing_StarterDeck.pdf — includes pilot/production tier examples and unit economics at different throughput levels. Ballpark pilot estimate included in the deck; we’ll follow with a formal SOW.
- SLA: We offer latency SLOs per plan; for an enterprise pilot we can commit to p95 targets and a credits structure. Connor will propose language for the MSA/order form.

Procurement & next steps:
- Attached: Mutual_Action_Plan_FINTECHCO.xlsx — outlines milestones, owners, and target dates.
- Proposed follow-ups: 30-min security call (Rishi + Priya) and 30-min commercial review (Connor + Raj) next week. I’ll send scheduling options after this note.

Attached files: Redwood_Security_Summary_v1.pdf, Redwood_Pricing_StarterDeck.pdf, Mutual_Action_Plan_FINTECHCO.xlsx

If helpful, Connor and I can draft a short pilot SOW and an initial redline of standard commercial terms for your review within 48 hours.

Best,
—Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Connor O'Brien <connor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-10T13:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Redwood Inference — procurement & security next steps (internal)

Internal notes / next actions from commercial side (keeping this internal so we can align language before sending):

1) Pricing approach: propose Pilot package = 30 days, capped spend $25k (includes reserved baseline + overage). For production options present 3 tiers (Startup, Business, Enterprise) with clear p95 targets and unit pricing. Marissa — can you confirm the expected pilot qps and approximate token volumes?
2) Contract edits: standard MSA with exceptions: limit on liability (mutual), data handling (customer owns PII), and security appendix. I’ll prepare an initial redline for Raj to review.
3) SLA language: propose p95 objective in order form with credits structure (1-5% credit tiers). Need legal review but keep commercially attractive.

Rishi — please confirm whether we can share the full SOC 2 under our standard NDA or if we need to route through security. Also confirm contact for technical deep-dive (Priya? or whoever FintechCo has).

I’ll draft the SOW outline and share in the next 24 hours.

—Connor
